lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Equipment modification EQ-2019-002 - disperser D-1 drive
The hydraulic drive unit of D-1 has been removed and replaced by a direct-coupled 45
kW electric motor with variable frequency drive (VFD).
No hydraulic circuit remains on D-1. Soft-start ramp 20 s. Commissioning 14/06/2019.
